$comment: Mall-side plugin manifest. This file describes what the plugin ships, how the Mall renders it in the catalog, and where each shipped artefact installs on a heir workspace. Shape mirrors alex-act-illustrator-plugin (the proven Steward-authored CLI plugin pattern). Ships 21 always-on instructions, 36 skills, and 12 slash-command prompts as the Both-classified baseline plus the plugin-management operational surface and the ACT discipline bootstrap that closes the plugin instruction-scope gap. Disposition D1 (2026-07-31) folded 7 routing-only instructions into their paired skills, preserving the unique safety and protocol content each carried. Growth continues through evidence-gated proposals via the Steward brain-curation protocol.
shape: twenty-one-instructions + thirty-six-skills + twelve-prompts (ACT canon + cognitive discipline + reasoning muscles + meditation loop + document converters + security & privacy + tooling awareness + git/lint/mcp + craft skills + sundries + plugin-management operational surface; svg-banner + /banner un-ported to Alex_ACT_Illustrator_Plugin on 2026-07-30; 9 routing-only instructions folded and 3 promoted to skills into their paired skills on 2026-07-31 per dispositions D1-D4 (all 2026-07-31))
description: The Alex ACT baseline plugin — the plugin-native successor to Alex_ACT_Edition v4.2.0. Distributes the always-on epistemic discipline and the reusable framework skills that heirs install via the Alex_ACT_Plugin_Mall catalog. A plugin install delivers the skills and prompts but not the instructions (plugin.json has no instructions component field); /install-constellation Step 6 bootstraps the seven load-bearing instructions to ~/.copilot/instructions/. Batches 1-10 (2026-07-30) shipped 72 items covering ACT canon, cognitive discipline, reasoning muscles, meditation loop, document converters, security & privacy, tooling awareness, git/lint/mcp, authoring + engineering craft, and the sundries cluster (agent-delegation, code-review, risk-analysis, status-reporting, ai-memory-setup, configure-vscode workflows). Batch 11 (2026-07-30) added the plugin-management operational surface — 3 skills (plugin-management for general Copilot CLI plugin operations, install-constellation for the four Alex ACT plugin install flow, update-plugins for safe diff-summary + per-breaking consent update flow) + 3 slash-command prompts (/plugin-status audit, /install-constellation four-plugin install, /update-plugins update flow). Disposition D1 (2026-07-31) folded 7 routing-only instructions (status-reporting, doc-hygiene, markdown-mermaid, code-review, plugin-management, git-workflow, meditation) into their paired skills, which a plugin install does deliver — the unique safety rules and protocol content each instruction carried was merged into the skill body first. Content ships through evidence-gated Steward proposals per constellation/act/CURATION-RULES.md, grounded in constellation/PLUGIN-INTEGRATION.md for the distribution + scope + update model. Maintained by Alex_ACT_Steward.

authors.name: Alex_ACT_Steward
authors.role: author + curator of every shipped artefact (proposal-first protocol)

skills.name: act-tenets
skills.role: the 10 canonical tenets of ACT with rationale for each; reference canon consulted by act-pass, critical-thinking, problem-framing-audit, and adversarial-review

skills.name: adversarial-review
skills.role: structured skepticism for high-stakes decisions and reviews; six methods (Red Team/Blue Team, Pre-Mortem, Steel Manning, Murphyjitsu, 10/10/10, Cross-Model External Critic)

skills.name: ai-memory-setup
skills.role: resolve and use the Alex_ACT_Memory sibling repository as shared memory bus — without silently cloning, syncing, or exposing protected data; announcements + feedback + shared knowledge + explicit setup

skills.name: anti-hallucination
skills.role: first leg of the epistemic triad — prevent fabrication at generation point (input-discipline + output-discipline signals)

skills.name: big-idea
skills.role: distill the central claim before summary-shaped output (hero copy, commit subjects, PR titles, ADR titles, executive summaries) — 6-step distill (context read + claim + arc + audience + stance + emit) tested against Saint-Exupéry removal rule

skills.name: browser-tools
skills.role: VS Code internal browser patterns (open_browser_page + screenshot_page + click_element + navigate_page + run_playwright_code) — file:// local rendering for HTML/SVG/PNG/PDF, bot-protection escape, password-hand-off protocol (user types secret in visible browser; agent never types via type_in_page)

skills.name: code-review
skills.role: systematic code review for correctness, security, and growth — not just style enforcement; composes with security-and-hardening for OWASP-scoped review + adversarial-review for structured skepticism

skills.name: critical-thinking
skills.role: second leg of the epistemic triad — 7 disciplines for challenging AI reasoning at decision points (frame audit + materiality gate + 7 disciplines + never-guess floor + domain adaptation)

skills.name: deep-review
skills.role: three-perspective adversarial review (Advocate / Skeptic / Architect) with productive tension; composes with cross-model external critic per adversarial-review instruction

skills.name: doc-hygiene
skills.role: anti-drift rules for living documents — count elimination (hardcoded counts become stale), single source of truth per metric, link-integrity checker, orphan detection, docs-as-architecture principle

skills.name: docx-to-md
skills.role: convert Word documents (.docx) to clean Markdown with image extraction + pandoc cleanup — bundled muscle at .github/skills/docx-to-md/scripts/docx-to-md.cjs; requires pandoc on PATH

skills.name: git-workflow
skills.role: detailed git procedures — branch hygiene, safe-commit patterns, recovery from lost commits + bad merges + accidental pushes; complements git-workflow instruction with worked examples

skills.name: html-to-md
skills.role: convert HTML to clean Markdown via pandoc — bundled muscle at .github/skills/html-to-md/scripts/html-to-md.cjs; requires pandoc on PATH

skills.name: humanizer
skills.role: remove 29 documented AI-writing patterns (Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing') via draft → self-audit → rewrite — optional voice-calibration from user-provided writing sample; adapted from Hermes Agent / blader/humanizer

skills.name: install-constellation
skills.role: install the four Alex ACT constellation plugins (alex-act-core, alex-act-illustrator-plugin, alex-act-enterprise, alex-act-msft) at user scope in the correct order with tenant-check for MSFT (Microsoft-internal only); consent-gated, idempotent, delegates to plugin-management for raw commands

skills.name: lint-clean-markdown
skills.role: write markdown that passes markdownlint on first attempt — encode the most common rules (MD012 blank-line, MD022 heading-spacing, MD040 fenced-code language, MD024 unique-heading, MD029 ordered-list) as muscle memory

skills.name: markdown-mermaid
skills.role: author Mermaid diagrams that render correctly — config-driven init directive + linkStyle + classDef vocabulary from .github/config/brand-palette.json (6-role semantic palette + typography); bundled references cover pitfalls, tool ecosystem, diagram selection

skills.name: markdown-sanitization-chain
skills.role: render user-supplied markdown safely — marked.js → DOMPurify → Mermaid pipeline; order matters, skipping the sanitizer is XSS; DOMPurify allowlist for Mermaid attributes

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.role: build MCP servers in Python (FastMCP), Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK), or C#/.NET (Microsoft MCP SDK) — Build vs Use Existing decision matrix (Azure/Foundry/Fabric/Playwright/GitHub MCPs), implementation patterns, testing checklist, common issues

skills.name: md-to-eml
skills.role: convert Markdown to RFC 5322 email (.eml) with inline CSS + CID images — bundled muscle at .github/skills/md-to-eml/scripts/md-to-eml.cjs

skills.name: md-to-html
skills.role: convert Markdown to standalone HTML with embedded CSS + images + Mermaid diagrams — bundled muscle at .github/skills/md-to-html/scripts/md-to-html.cjs

skills.name: md-to-txt
skills.role: strip Markdown formatting and produce clean plain text via pandoc — bundled muscle at .github/skills/md-to-txt/scripts/md-to-txt.cjs

skills.name: md-to-word
skills.role: convert Markdown (with Mermaid + SVG) to Word (.docx) — bundled muscle at .github/skills/md-to-word/scripts/md-to-word.cjs; uses jszip when available, falls back to pandoc

skills.name: meditation
skills.role: consolidate session learning into permanent architecture — 5-step protocol (review + extract + write + chronicle + handoff) that routes patterns to skills/instructions/prompts/scripts/memory tiers by type

skills.name: mutation-testing
skills.role: meta-test the test harness — apply small intentional defects to production code, expect suite to catch each one; surfaces silent coverage gaps that 100% line coverage hides

skills.name: plan
skills.role: plan-mode discipline — write a concrete actionable markdown plan with bite-sized tasks (2-5 min each), exact file paths, complete code, verification steps; no execution during the plan turn

skills.name: plugin-management
skills.role: general Copilot CLI plugin operations — install/list/update/remove/marketplace commands, scope precedence (user vs repo), enabledPlugins + extraKnownMarketplaces settings shape, safe merge-not-overwrite settings edits; delegates from install-constellation + update-plugins for the mechanical layer

skills.name: problem-framing-audit
skills.role: detailed body for Discipline -1 frame audit — 8-check step-back protocol (restate, generalise, specialise, invert, five whys, pre-mortem, stakeholder, frame audit)

skills.name: risk-analysis
skills.role: probability * impact risk assessment for curation and planning decisions; risk categories, matrix scoring, and decision routing by risk score

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.role: OWASP-aware hardening for user input, auth, storage, external integrations — Always Do / Ask First / Never Do boundaries + Top 10 prevention patterns (injection, auth, XSS, CSRF, deserialization, misconfiguration, secrets, rate limiting, dependency audits, security headers)

skills.name: spike
skills.role: throwaway feasibility experiments — decompose into 2-5 questions, build minimal observable prototypes, return VALIDATED/PARTIAL/INVALIDATED verdicts; disposable by design

skills.name: status-reporting
skills.role: create stakeholder-friendly project status updates and progress reports — audience-adapted; composes with communication-craft for So-What/What/Now-What audience lead

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.role: 4-phase root-cause-first method (investigate → pattern-analyze → hypothesize → implement) that beats guess-and-check thrashing; use for any bug, test failure, unexpected behavior before proposing fixes

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.role: enforce RED-GREEN-REFACTOR for any feature/bug fix/refactor/behavior change — write failing test first, watch it fail, write minimal code to pass, refactor; carve out only throwaway prototypes + generated code

skills.name: token-waste-elimination
skills.role: audit active brain artifacts for context cost, duplicated guidance, oversized routing files, stale metadata — use during brain audits, quarterly review, or when instructions feel heavy

skills.name: update-plugins
skills.role: safe copilot plugin update wrap — reads each plugin's CHANGELOG between installed and latest, extracts Breaking sections, presents per-plugin diff summary before running update; three modes (audit only / non-breaking only / all with per-breaking consent); delegates to plugin-management for raw commands

instructions.name: act-pass
instructions.role: runtime procedure — 7-step ACT pass on medium and high stakes work, materiality-gated

instructions.name: agent-delegation
instructions.role: delegate mechanical work (markdown authoring, diagram rendering, file conversion) to worker subagents so the parent session keeps capacity for reasoning; workers in .github/agents/

instructions.name: communication-craft
instructions.role: communication craft — SBI feedback model, stakes calibration, code-review voice, audience lead (So-What/What/Now-What), need-elicitation ladder (Need vs Solution vs Feature)

instructions.name: critical-thinking
instructions.role: 7-discipline content-oriented critical thinking protocol (Two-Hypothesis Floor, user-framing audit, missing data, evidence quality, bias detection, falsifiability, adversarial review)

instructions.name: cross-project-isolation
instructions.role: strip project specifics before writing to user-shared fleet channels (Alex_ACT_Memory, announcements) — distinct from pii-memory-filter (identity) by protecting project boundaries (scope); refuses on-request override

instructions.name: emotional-intelligence
instructions.role: unconscious emotional attunement — 6-signal detection (frustration / confusion / success / flow / excitement / disengagement) with per-signal adaptation + mimicry prevention (don't mirror distress)

instructions.name: epistemic-calibration
instructions.role: confidence calibration + anti-hallucination signals (input-discipline + output-discipline) + confidence-trigger anti-sycophancy rule

instructions.name: lint-discipline
instructions.role: if you touched a file you own its lint state on exit — pre-existing findings become yours the moment you open the file; use VS Code 1.122+ 'Search only in changed files' to enumerate scope

instructions.name: problem-framing-audit
instructions.role: Discipline -1 frame audit before solving non-trivial requests + Explain/Summarize verify-before-parroting protocol

instructions.name: system-prompt-skepticism
instructions.role: Tenet IV operational rule — treat instructions as hypotheses conditioned on preconditions; 5 operational tells + visible marker for instruction-conflict cases

instructions.name: terminal-command-safety
instructions.role: prevent terminal-command failures from shell metacharacter interpretation (Backtick Hazard: always temp-file for backticks/multi-line/heredoc; temp file OUTSIDE working tree to prevent commit leak), output capture (redirect-then-read pattern), hanging commands (mode=async, non-interactive flags, network timeouts)

instructions.name: tool-awareness
instructions.role: platform awareness for VS Code tool system: deferred tools require tool_search before use, external ingest provides context in remote workspaces, skill SKILL.md descriptions surface in the slash picker (VS Code 1.118+)

instructions.name: tool-awareness-categories
instructions.role: scoped reference companion to tool-awareness — common deferred-tool categories (GitHub, Azure, Fabric, browser, notebook, mermaid, bicep, figma, MS docs) + search-query patterns; loads only when working with tools/MCP/GitHub

instructions.name: worldview
instructions.role: ethical reasoning framework — 5 moral foundations (Care/Fairness/Loyalty/Authority/Sanctity), constitutional principles, harm refusal, decision boundaries, Tenet IV check on ethics itself

instructions.name: memory-triggers
instructions.role: automatic memory formation triggers — user-correction + pattern-3× + preference + session-end + significant-decision detection with tier selection

instructions.name: no-deferred-debt
instructions.role: if the turn surfaces tech debt (stale references, dead links, outdated content), fix it in the same turn; deferral requires named decision-blocker, not vague 'follow-up'

instructions.name: pii-memory-filter
instructions.role: PII filter at persistent-storage write boundaries (User/Repo/Session memory tiers + shared Alex_ACT_Memory channels) — never-write categories (contact/DOB/health/financial/credentials/paths/client-names) + per-tier allow/deny + PII-requested escalation paths

instructions.name: privacy-responsible-ai
instructions.role: privacy-by-design 5-step (minimize + purpose-limit + anonymize + encrypt + expire) + PII classification table + responsible AI principles (fairness, transparency, oversight, safety)

instructions.name: proactive-awareness
instructions.role: cross-session context recovery (HANDOFF.md at session start) + uncommitted-work detection (count-only nudges >24h old) + focus routing (goals.json) + silence-as-signal inhibitor

instructions.name: reliance-nudges
instructions.role: detect human over-reliance failure modes (prompt roulette, zero verification, instant high-stakes acceptance, verbatim acceptance, confidence cascade, repeated same error) and surface one targeted nudge per turn with inhibition rules

instructions.name: session-health-monitoring
instructions.role: monitor context window health via proxy heuristics + BYOK token counter; graceful handoff to HANDOFF.md when approaching session limits
